title: Group Anagrams
contract: Group lowercase words by character multiset; sort each group and sort group strings for deterministic output.
brute: List<List<String>> groups=new ArrayList<>();outer:for(String word:words){for(List<String> group:groups)if(sameLetters(word,group.get(0))){group.add(word);emit("Compare against existing group representatives","word",word);continue outer;}groups.add(new ArrayList<>(List.of(word)));}return groupOutput(groups);
optimal: Map<String,List<String>> groups=new HashMap<>();for(String word:words){int[] count=new int[26];for(char c:word.toCharArray())count[c-'a']++;String key=Arrays.toString(count);groups.computeIfAbsent(key,k->new ArrayList<>()).add(word);emit("Group by an unambiguous frequency signature","word",word,"signature",count);}return groupOutput(groups.values());
reasoning: Compare a word's counts with each group representative until an anagram group is found.
The full 26-count vector uniquely identifies a lowercase character multiset.
Serialize with separators so different vectors cannot collide accidentally. Output sorting is for reproducibility, and contributes extra cost separate from grouping.
